name: Ritz-Carlton Maldives, Fari Islands
insider_take: This isn't just another Maldives resort – it's where cutting-edge design meets pristine nature on a brand-new artificial archipelago that's redefining luxury in the Indian Ocean.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Maldives sits on the innovative Fari Islands, a sustainably-designed artificial archipelago that opened in 2021. The resort features the Maldives' first overwater spa pavilions and boasts Jean-Michel Cousteau's diving center – the only one of its kind in the region. Each villa comes with a dedicated Aris Meeha (island host) and the resort's circular design was inspired by the traditional Maldivian fishing boat, the dhoni.
pro_tip: Book the Sunset Water Villa for unobstructed views of the resort's famous infinity pool that seems to merge with the lagoon – it's one of the most Instagrammed spots in the Maldives.
dont_miss: The EcoCenter's turtle rehabilitation program where you can witness baby turtles being released into the wild, and the resort's unique "castaway" picnic experience on a completely uninhabited sandbank that appears only at low tide.
pros: Exceptional overwater and beach villa accommodations with private pools
World-class spa and wellness facilities with holistic treatments
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local Maldivian cuisine
Comprehensive water sports and marine activities including diving and snorkeling
cons: Remote island location requires seaplane transfer
Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
